summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the de facto standard in 2026 for connecting AI agents to external tools, data, and services through a uniform interface. The ecosystem spans individual MCP servers (e.g. GitHub, Playwright), aggregator platforms that bundle hundreds of integrations, and gateways/proxies that handle auth, routing, and security at scale. This matters because MCP lets any LLM-based agent read resources and invoke tools reliably without bespoke integration code, making agentic workflows portable across Claude, Cursor, and other hosts.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose a single system (one app or capability), aggregators expose many integrations behind one unified MCP endpoint, and gateways/proxies sit in front of servers to manage auth, rate-limiting, routing, and observability.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search and file contents
tools.pricing_paid: Free; usage governed by existing GitHub plan limits
strengths: Official first-party server with deep API coverage
Massive install base across Cursor, Claude, and VS Code
Automates repo, issue, and PR workflows
tools.best_for: Agent-driven code review, repo automation, and issue triage

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation — navigation, clicks, form fills, screenshots, and testing via accessibility tree
strengths: Lets agents control real browsers deterministically
Accessibility-tree based, avoiding brittle pixel parsing
Widely adopted for E2E testing and web scraping
tools.best_for: Automated browser testing and web interaction by AI agents

tools.name: Composio (Rube MCP)
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps including Gmail, Slack, Jira, Notion, Linear, and GitHub through one managed MCP endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Paid tiers for higher usage, team features, and managed auth (usage-based pricing)
strengths: Hundreds of pre-built integrations with managed OAuth
Single endpoint instead of running many servers
Strong developer tooling and Cursor support
tools.best_for: Rapidly giving agents access to many SaaS tools without self-hosting

tools.name: Figma MCP (Dev Mode MCP Server)
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, components, variables, and Dev Mode metadata for design-to-code
tools.pricing_paid: Requires Figma paid Dev/Full seat for Dev Mode features
strengths: Official design-to-code bridge
Feeds accurate design context to coding agents
Popular for frontend generation workflows
tools.best_for: Converting Figma designs into production UI code via agents

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Cloudflare Workers, remote MCP hosting, OAuth, and routing to downstream MCP servers
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans for higher usage and compute
strengths: Managed remote MCP hosting with built-in auth
Serverless deployment at edge scale
First-class remote MCP support
tools.best_for: Deploying and gating remote MCP servers in production

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, tables, SQL execution, migrations, and project management
tools.pricing_paid: Supabase paid plans for larger databases and projects
strengths: Official database access for agents
Query and manage schemas directly
Strong fit for full-stack AI app building
tools.best_for: Letting agents query and manage Postgres/Supabase backends

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspace content for read/write
tools.pricing_paid: Notion paid plans for team/workspace features
strengths: Official server for knowledge-base access
Read and update docs and databases
Popular for agent memory and documentation
tools.best_for: Agents managing docs, notes, and structured workspace data

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Registry of thousands of MCP servers with one-click install and hosted deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Paid tiers for hosted servers and higher usage
strengths: Largest MCP server registry and discovery hub
One-click install into popular clients
Hosted deployment option
tools.best_for: Discovering and installing MCP servers across the ecosystem

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Stripe payments, customers, invoices, products, and billing APIs
tools.pricing_paid: Free server; standard Stripe transaction fees apply
strengths: Official agent toolkit for payments
Safe, scoped access to billing operations
Growing adoption for commerce agents
tools.best_for: Agents handling payments, billing, and subscription workflows

tools.name: Docker MCP (MCP Toolkit / Catalog)
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers run in isolation via Docker Desktop, with a curated catalog and gateway
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Business/Team plans for org features
strengths: Secure, sandboxed execution of MCP servers
Curated catalog and one-command setup
Gateway for managing multiple servers
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers securely and consistently in containers

tools.name: Linear MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Linear issues, projects, cycles, and team workflows
tools.pricing_paid: Linear paid plans for larger teams
strengths: Official project-management integration
Create and update issues from agents
Clean remote MCP implementation
tools.best_for: Agents managing engineering tasks and project tracking

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: Directory of thousands of community and official MCP servers for discovery
strengths: Popular community discovery directory
Broad coverage of servers and clients
Good for finding niche integrations
tools.best_for: Browsing and discovering the full range of available MCP servers

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Sentry error tracking, issues, events, and performance data
tools.pricing_paid: Sentry paid plans for higher event volume
strengths: Official observability integration
Lets agents debug using real error context
Strong adoption in incident-response workflows
tools.best_for: Agents investigating and triaging production errors
